A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 19-page KVLink paper, including Appendices A.1–A.10. Pages 2–19 have identical extracted text and rendered images; page 1 differs only in code-access wording and the arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark and compression results in Tables 1–3, timing measurements in Figure 3, and appendix analyses in Table 5 and Figure 6.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark, compression, timing, and ablation results in Tables 1–3 and 5 and Figures 3 and 6.

M1.justification: Sections 2.1–2.4 and Appendix A.6 retain the same independent cache encoding, positional re-encoding, trainable link tokens, and compression-training procedures.

E1.justification: Section 3.1 and Appendix A.1 retain the same training mixture, five QA and two summarization evaluation datasets, general-capability benchmarks, and test scenarios.

E2.justification: PromptCache, CacheBlend, BlockAttention, and original/finetuned Llama retain their membership in the corresponding comparisons. The BlockAttention comparisons under compression in Table 3 are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The model configurations, training budgets, preprocessing, sample counts, metrics, compression rates, and timing protocols in Section 3 and Appendices A.1–A.3 are identical.

E4.justification: The link-token-count comparisons, training-mixture ablations in Table 5, and answer-document-position analysis in Figure 6 are unchanged. No supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions report timing measurements averaged over 100 runs with 10 initial warm-up trials in Section 3.3. Statistical reporting is otherwise identical, with no added uncertainty estimates or tests.

E6.justification: All numerical result entries and plotted findings in Tables 1–3 and 5 and Figures 3 and 6 are identical, including benchmark scores, latency, compression results, and appendix analyses.

T1.justification: The mathematical problem formulation, positional-encoding expressions, and compression formulation remain identical. No definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about cache reuse, predictive performance, inference efficiency, and compression compatibility. The code-location update does not change a scientific contribution.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and Appendix A.7 limitations are unchanged, including performance degradation after compression and the difficulty of storing variable-sized caches.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces the statement that code is available in supplementary material with a direct link to the UCSB-NLP-Chang/KVLink GitHub repository. This changes code-access instructions; implementation details remain identical.

R1.justification: Section 4, citations throughout the paper, and all 74 reference entries are unchanged. There is no revision to novelty claims or positioning against prior research.

P1.justification: One abstract sentence about code access and the arXiv version/date stamp change. The remaining prose, terminology, and section structure are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–7 and Tables 1–5 retain identical graphics, captions, placement, and formatting. The first-page wording and stamp updates do not reorganize the document layout.

improvement.justification: Replacing the supplementary-material pointer with a specific repository link makes the code-access instructions more actionable, providing a small documentation improvement. Scientific content and appendix evidence are unchanged. The PDFs alone do not establish the repository's contents or completeness.
